recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: bananas finally breaking soil in a rayleigh garden after fifteen winters
engineers chasing operational excellence in ai-accelerated builds
developers burning through tokens to learn how to save them
overcast july morning hanging over san francisco at thirteen degrees
celtic harp tones drifting through summer fog banks
stutter-house pulses rippling under gray california skies

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap on stutter-house beat drops as pulses ripple through a foggy SF skyline; miss a beat and you drop a lane into the bass.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each 30-second round is one track build toward a satisfying chorus hit.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, ghost notes appear, and the fog thickens between lanes.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe over gray overcast fog

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Hold to water underground banana shoots in a British garden; release before roots rot from overwatering as seasons flash past.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Watching a sprout peek through soil after nailing the perfect water window.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Seasons accelerate, frost warnings blink, and drought gaps shrink.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper cutout botanical sketch with muted earth tones

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort prompt fragments into compression bins before the token meter overflows—keep meaning, shed noise.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: A clean stack triggers a satisfying tokens-saved cascade.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Fragments grow longer, red herrings multiply, meter drains faster.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe between fog layers to catch drifting Celtic harp tones before they dissolve into the overcast.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Three clean catches in a row trigger a brief harmonic swell.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Fog layers multiply and tones decay faster as wind picks up.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor mist with gold-leaf harp strings
